command: C:\Windows\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command "`$nodes=(Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/CampusNetwork_02/nodes').name; `$cmd=[uri]::EscapeDataString('display current-configuration'); foreach(`$n in `$nodes){ `$o=(Invoke-RestMethod -Uri ('http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/CampusNetwork_02/nodes/'+`$n+'/command?cmd='+`$cmd)).output -split '\r?\n'; `$m=`$o | Where-Object { `$_ -match '160\.0\.0\.1|traffic-policy|policy-based-route|route-policy|ip route-static|nqa|redirect' }; if(`$m){ Write-Output ('### '+`$n); `$m } }"
